summary: zip_longest combines lists element by element, filling missing values with fillvalue until the longest list is exhausted (via itertools.zip_longest).
questions: How do I zip lists of unequal length without losing items?

answer_card.title: zip_longest filter
answer_card.answer_md: `zip_longest` aggregates elements from each list; if lengths differ, missing values are filled with `fillvalue`, continuing until the longest list ends. Mostly a passthrough to `itertools.zip_longest`.
